high_level_description: The vast Zócalo square of Mexico City on a bright day with a giant Mexican flag on a tall pole, the grey stone Metropolitan Cathedral with its bell towers, and a friendly police officer in a vest.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A huge open paved square under a deep blue sky, with low colonial buildings around it.

elements.desc: The Metropolitan Cathedral, a huge grey stone Baroque church with two tall bell-shaped towers and a central dome.
A very tall flagpole with an enormous green, white and red flag flying in the wind, with no emblem visible.

In the middle distance, a small figure of a woman police officer in a dark uniform, a bright yellow-green vest and a cap, pointing the way, the same size as the other people in the square and far smaller than the cathedral.
People strolling across the square, small in the distance.
